title: Flint Avenue / G Street / Pioneer Avenue / Temporary Closure / Public Nuisance / Illegal Dumping
motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the City Engineer be instructed to report with recommendations to temporarily close Flint Avenue from G Street to Pioneer Avenue, Pioneer Avenue from Flint Avenue to G street, and the Y-shaped alley adjacent to Pioneer Avenue south of G Street and east of Flint Avenue, pursuant to State Vehicle Code Section 21101.4 PRESENTED BY: TIM McOSKER Councilmember, 15th District SECONDED BY: 00/(0/406 50majs AUG 2 8 2026
